chapter: Sam Morgan, La Vida and Ridgley
title: Piron's band from 1932 to 1935 and its singer
summary: Williams repeats that he was with Piron from 1932 to 1935 and lists the band, with singer Harold Wells.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: He always was a musician, you see. He learned the right way. Oh yeah, a musician. That's what I did. He was great, good. Always have been. What about P-Rom's band? P-Rom's band? I played with P-Rom's band from 32 to 35. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with with Song that was after that. He broke up the band. Now his band consists of P. Ron's band, when I first started playing, consists of me, P. Ron, Lil' Allegrette Alexander, Eddie Pearson on trombone, Joe Phillips, Leo Dejon, Sales, Arthur Durden, Ellia Taylor, and Simon Moreira on the page. That's the band on the book. That's the band on the book. And Harry Wells was our singer. He died. He lived too fast. Fine singer.
